summary: Manual extraction for rakudai-kishi-main vol-21, covering the aftermath of Eilands' abduction of Stella, the Nikko underground-lab rescue, Eilands' perfect-human project and Darwin/Abraham defenses, Ikki and Shizuku's battle against Eilands, Eilands' possession of Stella and destruction of the lab, Edelweiss' intervention, Shizuku's fusion magic, Ikki restoring Stella through their mutual rivalry and admiration, Fu Xiaoli's destruction of Eilands' true brain in Yellowstone, the postwar decision by Itsuki and Tsukikage to end the old Rebellion-based world system, and the October epilogue in which Ikki and Stella prepare for KOK A-class and their wedding in Vermillion.
notes: Only character and event files were created per p1-scan instruction.
Chapter 7 is author afterword; no in-world character/event extraction was added from it.
The source chapter headers call this 第十九卷 while the task/source path is vol-21; index records the task volume as vol-21 and preserves the source's in-text title wording.

Kurono, Nene, Moroboshi and Amane are primarily epilogue/news references; only Kurono received a file because the recap and epilogue provide direct state changes relevant to vol-21. Nene, Moroboshi and Amane remain represented within the October event.
